rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb when a liquid, river, or stream moves from one place to another.

example.english: I watched the water flow down from the mountain.
example.traditional: 我見到啲水由山上流落嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 di1 seoi2 jau4 saan1 soeng6 lau4 lok6 lei4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for continuous movement in a mass or fluid, often appearing in compounds such as 人流 and 水流.

example.english: The flow of people here is really heavy.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 jan4 lau4 hou2 wong6

rows.note: Use this for the amount or rate of fluid moving through a pipe, valve, or other system.

example.english: The water flow through this pipe is too low.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 seoi2 hau4 ge3 lau4 loeng6 taai3 sai3

rows.note: Use this construction when an action, performance, or piece of writing proceeds smoothly.

example.english: When I write, my words can flow smoothly, so I finish drafts much faster.
example.traditional: 我寫嘢寫得順，交稿快好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 se2 je5 se2 dak1 seon6 gaau1 gou2 faai3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for how smoothly something proceeds, especially speech, writing, movement, or a design.

example.english: Your report has quite a smooth flow.
example.traditional: 你份報告嘅流暢度幾高喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 lau4 coeng3 dou6 gei2 gou1 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the tide's rising phase rather than for fluid flow in general.

example.english: The tide will flow in tomorrow morning, so don't go swimming.
example.traditional: 聽日朝早漲潮，唔好去游水。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 zoeng3 ciu4 m4 hou2 heoi3 jau4 seoi2

rows.note: Use 飄 when fabric or another light object hangs loosely and waves in the air.

example.english: You can watch the sheer curtain by the window flow in the breeze.
example.traditional: 窗邊幅薄紗畀風吹到飄住。
example.jyutping: coeng1 bin1 fuk1 bok6 saa1 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 dou3 piu1 zyu6

rows.note: Use 漲潮 specifically when describing the tide rising rather than ebbing.

example.english: The tide will flow in soon, so don't walk farther out.
example.jyutping: zoeng3 ciu4 laa3 m4 hou2 zoi3 haang4 gam3 ceot1
